# External dependencies of FuguPass. scripts/deps installs each line.

# The test dist entry takes the signify tier, and scripts/deps
# needs signify(1) to check that signature. The tool environment
# installs before every other one, so the command is there when the
# test chain reaches the entry.
tool pkg signify-openbsd

# The secret gate of make check runs gitleaks, so the tool
# environment installs it before every other environment.
tool bin gitleaks https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/v8.30.1/gitleaks_8.30.1_{os}_{arch}.tar.gz gitleaks

# tests/harness starts each counterparty with Fugu::Process, and it
# waits for readiness with Fugu::Timeout (TEST-HARNESS-6). make
# check runs no harness, so the entry sits in the test environment.
test dist https://github.com/FuguBSD/Fugu/releases/latest/download/Fugu.tar.gz
